description: Composite figure combining four secondary-electron SEM images and one EBSD phase map of the same specimen. (a1) is a low-magnification SEM view (20 µm scale bar) of a wavy, lamellar multiphase structure with yellow arrows labelling regions "α" and "α+γ". (a2) shows the same constituents at 5 µm scale, arrowed "α" and "α+γ". (a3) (3 µm scale bar) resolves blocky/plate-like "α" regions embedded in a finer "α+γ" constituent. (a4) is the highest-magnification view (2 µm scale bar), arrowed "α" in the upper right and a field printed as "α'+γ", with fine bright particles scattered over the surface. (b) is an EBSD phase map with a 5 µm scale bar containing only two colour classes, white and orange; the orange phase forms interconnected bands and stringers that wrap around large equiaxed white grains. Per the caption the coloured (orange) phase is austenite, so the map resolves α-ferrite plus austenite. No phase fractions, compositions or plot axes are printed anywhere in the figure; the citing text reports 45 % austenite for M1-IA versus 19 % for M2-IA. The panels jointly demonstrate that M1-IA is an α-ferrite + austenite microstructure with banded/lamellar austenite morphology.

observations.observation: Panel (a1) is a low-magnification SEM image with a 20 µm scale bar showing a wavy/lamellar multiphase structure, with yellow arrows labelling areas "α" and "α+γ".
Panel (a2) shows the same specimen at higher magnification with a 5 µm scale bar, again with yellow arrows labelling "α" and "α+γ".
Panel (a3) has a 3 µm scale bar and shows blocky/plate-like "α" regions embedded in a finer "α+γ" constituent.
Panel (a4) has a 2 µm scale bar and carries an arrow labelled "α" at the upper right plus a field printed as "α'+γ"; fine bright secondary-phase particles are dispersed over the surface.

Panel (b) is a two-colour EBSD phase map with a 5 µm scale bar; only white and orange appear, and the orange phase forms elongated interconnected bands/stringers that surround large equiaxed white grains.
No phase fraction, composition value, diffraction angle or axis label is printed anywhere in this figure; the only numeric annotations are the scale bars (20, 5, 3, 2 and 5 µm).
The caption states that (a1–a4) are SEM images of the M1-IA sample showing the presence of different phases.
The caption states that (b) is the EBSD phase map for the M1-IA sample and that the coloured phase represents austenite (hence orange = austenite, white = α-ferrite).
The citing text states that the SEM microstructures were acquired in secondary electron (SE) mode.
The citing text states that the M1-IA sample consists of α-ferrite and austenite, while δ-ferrite is present only in the M2-IA sample.
The citing text states that quantitative phase analysis gives 45 % austenite for M1-IA and 19 % austenite for M2-IA; these numbers are not printed in this figure.
The citing text states that intercritically annealed microstructures contain only a negligible amount of martensite in both samples.
